title: 上下文可以丢，项目事实不能丢：长期智能体开发真正要保存什么
proposition: Version-bound artifacts and acceptance evidence must survive transient conversational context.
synopsis: Long-running work needs durable candidate identity, artifacts, evidence and role boundaries; past acceptance cannot transfer automatically to a changed candidate.
causalScene: A fleeting translucent sheet lifts away while a precise cobalt evidence folio remains firmly bound to its matching candidate.
titlePromise: Save authoritative project facts instead of relying on endless chat.
readerProblem: What must persist when a session ends?
dominantSubject: One durable cobalt folio of aligned artifact and evidence leaves
visibleResult: The version-matched bound folio remains intact.
colorSemantics: Cobalt is durable authoritative facts; near-transparent ice blue is transient context; violet inset binds identity.
composition: Large stable folio in lower foreground, one departing translucent sheet above, airy background.
material: Fine cobalt ceramic leaves, satin binding, translucent frosted sheet
palette: Cobalt, ivory, pale ice blue, tiny violet accent
